PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId, @{N='Mem\(MB\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSetSize/1MB,1\)}}, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)
